placement: Fixed 2x4 regions at {38 8} for lane0 and {38 28} for lane3 pair FF/mux cells; real half-cycle paths kept short without PHY RTL changes or internal false paths.
timing_scope: Internal DDR/monitor/transmitter/reset paths; external data to first IOL remains phase-calibrated and excepted, not a proven input-eye margin.
drc: No multi-drive, no abnormal timing path; PHY-5079 notes one local clock routing segment on clk_50m, included in routed STA. No other critical warning permitted by bitgen gate.
simulation_limit: Ideal digital primitives; guard/TERC4-style payload compared bit-exactly on four lanes, not a valid generated LPCM packet or electrical/SDF test. PAD regression uses mapped IN_DFFMODE=NONE instead of the earlier FF setting; fixed input tap eye remains a board test.
ports: PC HDMI -> HDMIA; HDMIB -> HDMI monitor
edid: Official AnlogicHDMI ROM unchanged; preferred 720p60 RGB8; two-channel 48kHz 24-bit LPCM descriptor 09/04/04; both checksums zero.
hpd: Official 2^25 startup cycles at 50MHz, about 671ms; explicitly reset at startup. Downstream B-HPD sampled and displayed but not required to transmit, as in official sender.
transport: Reuse board-tested four-lane IDDRx2/pair-retime/ODDR raw relay, including TMDS clock and all data islands; no RGB/DVI rewrite, frame buffer, or separate audio clock.
ddc_diagnostics: Passive custom observer never drives SDA; B-page request-low bit forced zero and parser state describes observer, not official I2C FSM.
previous_board_evidence: Old B-to-A raw relay passed main-source video. Official A-to-B RGB baseline enumerated as AnlogicHDMI at 1280x720 60Hz RGB8 SDR but monitor was blank. These prior tests are not board pass for this combined candidate.
prior_candidate_board_result: 4C311166/3967cf0 failed: LED2/3 on, LED4 off, monitor no signal. User video shows 1220, BFD0, AFEE/AFEF and C777/C711. Clock/PLL and aligned phases pass, format never qualifies, phase scan continues.
root_fix: Require eight HDMI island-preamble control words on lanes1/2 before guard/TERC4 sync interpretation. Balanced legal RGB 55/55 with B=6d/6c/ba encodes 133/133 and 28e/271/2c3: old guard-only logic produced false HS/VS and rejected valid frames. Reproduction fails on old RTL and passes on patched RTL; invalid geometry still rejected. This is a confirmed code defect, not proof it is the only real-board cause.
top_regression: Candidate now uses scaled 192x16 geometry with legal RGB alias bands, eight-word island/video preambles and 32-word island-style payload. Latency search starts on varying packet words to avoid flat-color periodic aliases; all four lanes retain common 11-UI delay. Production geometry remains 1650x750/8 frames.
board_report_20261010: User confirms extended desktop and local video have no image corruption or periodic blackout and audio is synchronized. Independent PC-to-A/B-to-monitor AV only; duration, unplug/replug and cold-start counts were not provided. Museum integration is not yet board-passed.
final_port_policy: User accepts A-input/B-output as final only after existing museum functions are preserved and board-regressed; independent candidate does not meet that condition yet.
